_comment: The ONLY roles the infra deploy identity may assign. bootstrap.bicep reads this file to build the ABAC condition
on that identity's Role Based Access Control Administrator assignment, so this is the single place the set lives.
Every role a resource-group template assigns MUST be here, or its deployment fails with AuthorizationFailed.
Every entry here MUST either be assigned by a resource-group template or carry 'reserved' naming the plan item
that will assign it. `scripts/infra-ci.py check` enforces both directions.
Adding a role widens what CI can grant. It needs a bootstrap re-run by a subscription Owner, which is the point:
CI cannot widen its own rights.
These are Microsoft's public built-in role definition ids, identical in every tenant. They are not secrets.

e147488a-f6f5-4113-8e2d-b22465e65bf6.role: Key Vault Crypto Service Encryption User
